Class OfferTileView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.Board.OfferTileView
public class OfferTileView extends Object
View controller for a single offer tile on the game board. Displays the tile image and the totem of the player currently occupying it. Handles mouse interaction and delegates selection to OfferTileController.

  • Method Details

    • setController

      public void setController(OfferTileController offerController)
      Injects the parent offer tile controller into this view.
      Parameters:
      offerController - the controller to notify when this tile is selected

    • setOffer

      public void setOffer(OfferTileDTO offer)
      Sets the offer tile data and loads the tile image from resources. Called once during initialization for each tile.
      Parameters:
      offer - the DTO of the offer tile to display

    • updateTotem

      public void updateTotem(OfferTileDTO offer)
      Updates the totem image displayed on this tile. If the tile has no occupant, clears the totem image. Otherwise, loads and displays the totem image for the occupant color, aligning it to the top center of the tile.
      Parameters:
      offer - the updated DTO containing the current occupant color

    • getDTO

      public OfferTileDTO getDTO()
      Returns the DTO of the offer tile currently displayed by this view.
      Returns:
      the current OfferTileDTO

    • setInteractable

      public void setInteractable(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables interaction with this offer tile. When disabled, resets any active visual effect.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true to make this tile interactable, false to disable it

    • handleOfferClick

      public void handleOfferClick()
      Applies a click effect and notifies the parent controller when the tile is clicked. Ignored if the tile is disabled.

    • handleOfferEnter

      public void handleOfferEnter()
      Applies a hover effect when the cursor enters the tile and calls the totem placement action in the client controller. Ignored if the tile is disabled.

    • handleOfferExit

      public void handleOfferExit()
      Resets the visual effect when the mouse exits the tile. Ignored if the tile is disabled.

    • resetStyle

      private void resetStyle()
      Resets the visual effect.
